preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of flights m is between 1 and 5000, inclusive.
Each flight is from city ai to city bi, where ai is less than bi and both are between 1 and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: There exists a path from city 1 to city n using the given flights.
preconditions.description: It is guaranteed that there exists a way to travel from city number 1 to city number n using the given flights.

preconditions.expression: There are no cyclical paths or duplicate flights between the same pair of cities.
preconditions.description: It is guaranteed that there is no sequence of flights that forms a cyclical path and no two flights are between the same pair of cities.

postconditions.expression: Output is either 'Yes' or 'No' followed by m integers.
postconditions.description: The output should indicate whether it is possible to change the flight durations and, if possible, provide the new durations.

postconditions.expression: If 'Yes', then all paths from city 1 to city n take the same time.
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', then it must be possible to adjust the flight durations such that any path from city 1 to city n takes exactly the same amount of time.

postconditions.expression: Each flight duration is either 1 or 2.
postconditions.description: The durations of the flights must be either 1 or 2.

postconditions.expression: Output the durations in the order of the input flights.
postconditions.description: The output should list the new durations of the flights in the same order as the flights are given in the input.
